title: Arquitectura desafío (fastapi-ml)
summary: A machine-learning model deployment architecture and pipeline (FastAPI, Kubernetes, DVC, GCP) built as a technical challenge submission, including a data-augmentation script that creates a synthetic version of the training dataset for monitoring tests. The Fake-data/dataset-fake.py script imports GaussianCopula from sdv.tabular to generate this fake dataset.
